claim: Make materialization notes persist: the /materialize skill requires each action item to carry notes referencing the directive's reasoning for traceability, but CB.Materializer.Sink.JSON records only id/action/source/created/status and drops extra keys by design, so the promised traceability never lands - not in the todo record, not in the materialized link-back refs. Either the default sink persists notes (and the link-back carries them) or the skill stops mandating what the flow discards; the silent divergence between the skill's contract and the sink's behavior is the part that must not survive.

evidence.detail: Live specimen at the materialize flow's first batch use: the b513/b514 discharge wrote rationale notes on all four action items (t0003-t0006) per the skill's traceability rule; the sink ignored them by documented design and the flow reported success - same species as agent-behavior:a405, a success message describing the code path rather than the state that landed. Preflight 2026-06-11: 2 schema hits, both bare tag-overlap (b494 backlog family, b498 write-flow family), reviewed per b055 - no active structure contradicted; the b519 calibration pattern applies.

Second live specimen, at the very next materialization (the b512 discharge, t0007-t0009): the skill's traceability mandate was followed - all three action items carried notes - and the JSON sink dropped them by documented design while the flow reported success. The divergence reproduces on every materialization until the sink persists notes or the skill stops mandating them.

Discharged 2026-06-11 (materialized t0010-t0011): persistence chosen over dropping the mandate - the notes are real traceability, so the JSON sink now carries a non-empty notes key on both the todo record and the materialized link-back ref (blank or absent notes stay omitted; other extra keys still pass to custom sinks only), and the /materialize skill's sink description matches. The discharge's own materialization ran through the fixed sink and its notes landed in todos.json and the link-back - the live demonstration that the divergence is closed.
